external_source: QRData billboard_impact.csv (Causal Inference for the Brave and True, ch.13), gold DiD estimate (CC BY-NC 4.0, xxxiaol/QRData) — external anchor, no GADS recipe pinned (drafted lane by design)

local_attempt.note: A Planner replan's structured-output JSON exceeded the configured max_tokens ceiling (Instructor retry exhaustion: 'output is incomplete due to a max_tokens length limit'), and the failure propagated as a fatal, unrecoverable halt rather than degrading gracefully. Two execution steps (data load, interaction-term creation) completed before the halt but produced no captured stdout and no causal estimate. No GADS-canonical local value exists for this benchmark. See notes.md.

estimate.note: GADS canonical from cloud reference run (drafted lane, deposits ~ poa + jul + poa:jul OLS DiD): ATE = +6.52, matching QRData's external gold to the reported precision (both 6.52). Tolerance tightened from the provisional band now that a reference run exists; kept non-zero (not exact) because the drafted plan's exact regression formulation is not contractually fixed the way a pinned recipe's would be, so a repeat run choosing an equivalent-but-differently-specified DiD model could differ in the last decimal.
